full_page.content:
1932, July
FR. SOLNAUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Blank Page
July Robert Briskey - 20 month baby - rupt. - not able to walk, though bright otherwise
Mrs. Sanford - 37 - 2 children threatened with T.B. of Knee John Koselka - 33 - Saline, Mich. - 13 yrs. sleeping sickness Mrs. B. Dhoudt - 32 - T.B. has 2 small children - Husband asks prayers.
Cyril Duhausshere - 46 - asthma - heart
Edmond Vier - 47 - 7 children, threatened with bankrupsy ..... would sell some of
L. Van St. - 46 - cured of incurable disease - suffers for 3 yrs spends all money only - worry - promised to come to monastery as soon as possible and is cured.
Mt. Vernon Pk.
Mrs. DuH from Chicago - blind
Mrs. Wm Scott of Flint - husband convert - neglecting family & wife ...
Page 57 Page 58 July 29
Blank Page
Alphons Girardot - 29 - of Sandwich, Ont. spinal - bad case of arthritis.
Mrs. Keitzler - 6 rooms house - Garage to rent.
Branden M. O'Connor - 34 - stomach trouble - out of work ....
Jean Dorothy Warde 6, had fits since 3 mo. old till 2 yrs. ago when 20 a day sometime - taken here & enrolled Since that time has not had a spell ...
Jay Dawson - 39 - had teeth extracted because of rhumatic condition - then tonsils removed and still no improvement - To-day enrolls in S.M.A. for 1 yr- promising perpet. enrolm't - 2 weekly Communion if . .
Page 55 Page 56
